When a constraint with validation="Error" is violated, the BlockML
validator emits BML_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION and compilation fails.

When a constraint with validation="Information" is violated, the BlockML
validator emits BML_CONSTRAINT_INFORMATION. Compilation continues.

When a constraint with validation="Warning" is violated, the BlockML
validator emits BML_CONSTRAINT_WARNING. Compilation continues.

Workflow:
1. Author or update Blocks under org.blockml.bml.vscode (types, docs, BlockMlExtension) and
   highlight schemes under org.blockml.bml.vscode.theme.*.
2. Export new types via Library.bml blocks when publishing catalogue membership.
3. Run an LLM or deterministic generator with this library + BlockMlExtension as context.
4. Emit / update: package.json, syntaxes, icons, README.md (from doc:MarketplaceListing),
   CHANGELOG.md, src/extension.ts, language client, tests.
5. Diff generated artefacts against BML — drift means regenerate or amend BML first.

Rules for generators:
• Do not add contributes.* entries missing from BlockMlExtension.contributions
• Do not add settings missing from ConfigurationContribution.settings
• Honour milestone and enabled when filtering V1 vs V2 output
• Prefer updating BML over hand-editing generated files for durable changes
• Emit language-configuration.json only from LanguageContribution comment/pair fields
• When LanguageContribution.xmlLanguageParticipant is true, emit
  contributes.xmlLanguageParticipants[{ languageId }] so vscode-xml still honours XSD /
  xsi:schemaLocation for that language (BML files are XML with language id bml)
• Emit tmLanguage only from GrammarContribution patterns / topLevelIncludes / scopes
• When GrammarContribution.highlightScheme is set, derive framework tag patterns (tagRoot,
  tagIdentity, tagContainer, tagFacet, plus domain fallback tag) from that scheme's
  roles / tags / textMateScope / domainScope — do not invent framework tag lists only in JSON
• Changing a HighlightScheme (tags or scopes) requires an explicit LLM / generator re-render
  of GrammarContribution patterns and syntaxes/*.tmLanguage.json — never auto-build on save
• Emit icon theme JSON only from IconContribution theme* / iconPath / fileExtension fields
• When IconContribution.contributeLanguageIcon is true, emit
  contributes.languages[].icon { light, dark } from iconPath / iconPathDark on the matching
  LanguageContribution
• Emit contributes.iconThemes only when IconContribution.contributeIconTheme is true. The
  Extension Development Host auto-applies the first registered file icon theme on F5.
• Emit color theme JSON only from ColorTheme (tokenColors, editorForeground/Background,
  label, uiTheme, themePath) referenced by ColorThemeContribution — do not invent colors only
  in themes/*.json
• Emit contributes.themes only when ColorThemeContribution.contributeTheme is true. The
  Extension Development Host auto-applies the first registered color theme on F5.
• When ColorThemeContribution.overlayTokenColors is true, emit
  contributes.configurationDefaults editor.tokenColorCustomizations.textMateRules from
  ColorTheme.tokenColors whose scope ends in .bml — omit xml / other languages
• When ColorThemeContribution.overlaySemanticTokenColors is true, emit
  contributes.configurationDefaults editor.semanticTokenColorCustomizations.rules from
  TokenColorRule entries that set semanticTokenType. Key each rule as type:bml (language
  suffix) with foreground and optional bold/fontStyle. Selector may include a modifier
  (*.unnecessary:bml for unused root xmlns). Also emit semanticTokenColors in
  themes/*.json from the same rules. Do not rely on semanticTokenScopes + tokenColorCustomizations
  alone — VS Code does not style custom semantic types from TextMate overlay rules.
• Emit contributes.semanticTokenModifiers from SemanticHighlightingContribution.tokenModifiers
  (unnecessary fades unused root xmlns:<prefix> declarations). The client legend must include
  those modifiers or the LSP bits are ignored.
• When ColorThemeContribution.marketplace is true and contributeTheme is true, add Themes
  to package.json categories and emit contributes.themes[].id from ColorTheme.themeId
• When ColorTheme.highlightScheme is set, verify tokenColors cover every
  HighlightRole.textMateScope, domainScope, and GrammarContribution.scopes entry
• For V1 (no LanguageServerContribution in the filtered set): omit package.json main and
  activationEvents even if Extension.main / activationEvents are present in BML for V2
• Emit README.md only from doc:MarketplaceListing — the Marketplace page must state that V1
  syntax support is limited (no language server; LSP arrives in V2). vscode:README is the
  library reading entry, not the listing.
